availability_policy: Next business day. The retrieval timestamp in this manifest is when the file was downloaded, which is an upper bound on availability for the last observation and says nothing about when earlier observations became available.
revision_policy: Rarely revised, but the observation WINDOW moves; see BAMLCC0A0CMTRIV. Not point-in-time. FRED serves only the current vintage of a series; revisions overwrite history in place and this endpoint exposes no vintage. Historical vintages exist in ALFRED (https://alfred.stlouisfed.org) and are not read by this module. A sha256 here identifies the file downloaded, not what the series looked like on any earlier date.
